Game Overview

Sprunki Happy Easter 2Player is a two-player title where join the Sprunki brothers in a festive race to collect the most Easter eggs. Dash against a sibling or friend, snatching colorful treasures and racing to the chest. With quick reflexes and a competitive spirit, prove you're the ultimate egg collector in this lively holiday showdown!
